recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. The published FHIR-7574 decision is represented in current source, and the narrow link correction keeps the existing guidance reachable without reopening the broader MustSupport/obligations model.
issue_request: FHIR-7574 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked for more precise conformance keywords so profiles could distinguish required-but-may-be-empty expectations from optional/don't-care elements, and the accepted action was to provide explicit MustSupport guidance for profile authors and harmonize the multiple MustSupport descriptions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6100, imported as git commit b4055a8d2d6f005ac8df2ad2c64bdd505535325a, which changed conformance-rules.html, profiling.html, and datatypes/elementdefinition.xml to say that profiles using mustSupport SHALL explain exactly what support is required.
additional_context: Current build-scope source still contains the requested MustSupport rule in profiling.html, ElementDefinition source, conformance rules, and obligations.html. Later source history moved the detailed application-behavior guidance toward the Implementation Obligations page. The conformance module and documentation pages actively link to profiling.html, conformance-rules.html, elementdefinition.html, and obligations.html. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7574 found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Changed the malformed href in source/profiling.html from obligations.html> to obligations.html so the Must Support section reaches the detailed Implementation Obligations guidance. No new conformance keywords or redundant prose were added.
source_changes: source/profiling.html: fixed the Must Support section's malformed obligations link from href="obligations.html>" to href="obligations.html".
